result.summary: The home feed renders cleanly overall, but the "Fastest near you" carousel shows the same restaurant card (Green Bowl Poké, 15–25 min, €0.90 delivery) twice in a row, which points to a duplicated list item. No other clear visual defects were found; the clipped carousel item at the right edge and the cut-off card at the bottom are expected scrolling behaviour.

issues.description: The "Fastest near you" carousel shows the identical "Green Bowl Poké" card in the first and second positions, with the same image, 15–25 min badge and €0.90 delivery fee. This looks like a duplicated data entry or rendering bug and wastes prime carousel space.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the carousel items by restaurant ID before rendering, and check the backend response and list keying so each restaurant appears only once.
